heading: `no response`
text:
### `no response` [LTSL.7.5]

`no response` declares an intentionally-unanswered call — the timeout / absence path
a rule detects with a `timeout` continuation or a negated pattern over the
response schema bounded by `within` ([LCRS.7.1]).

A stub for a call of a service that declares `no response` ([LADP.8.4.2]) must
contain only `no response`; the compiler must reject one that contains a reply
(`DS_VALIDATE_TEST_STUB_NO_RESPONSE_MISMATCH`).
